_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: near_eastern (egyptian) backbone + mesoamerican (mayan) overlay (cross-family blend, Egyptian-leaning)

blend.backbone: near_eastern (egyptian register: per/nesut/heqa, the itru river-cult and the solar god-king, theophoric on morphed canon-stems, dj/tj/kh, -aa/-et endings, construct-chain toponyms)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (mayan: the witz pyramid-acropolis and carved stela, the k'uhul ajaw holy-lord and the Long-Count, jade and cacao and quetzal-feather, glottalized stops, vigesimal counting)
blend.lean: Egyptian-heavy - a solar temple-kingdom of the great river enthroned over the jungle pyramid-cities: the per-aa and his nesut-court and itru river-cult dominate the register, the Maya witz and ch'ib'al-lineages and jade-and-cacao wealth endure beneath. The disc over the feathered glyph, the mummy and the jade-masked king.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_05 (Egyptian / Near-Eastern egyptian sub-palette) x BASE_10 (Mayan / Mesoamerican mayan sub-palette). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parents are civ, so Ramaya is Civilized (feudal). Concept: an Egypto-Mesoamerican realm - two sun-and-pyramid temple-civilizations fused, the Nile and the jungle, the solar disc over the feathered glyph, the mummy and the jade-masked king. Egyptian-LEAN: Egyptian phonology + the temple/Nile/rule register dominant; Mayan substrate supplies the jungle/pyramid/material/staple words. Backbone = Egyptian (Abydosian: the per-aa solar kingship, the itru river-cult, the nesut-court, the construct-chain toponyms, the dj/tj/kh phonology); overlay/substrate = Mayan (Ixalan: the witz pyramids, the ch'ib'al-lineages, the jade/cacao/maize/feather wealth, the glottalized stops). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Egyptian and Maya registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Egyptian reflexes primary via abydosian, Mayan morphs secondary via family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.mayan), never real Egyptian/Maya gods. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved foreign term - 'Pharaoh' at the kingdom tier); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. APPROVED FOREIGN TERM: kingdom display = 'Pharaoh' (the commonly-known foreign rank, like 'Sultan' or 'Tsar').

phonology.palette: Egyptian (Afro-Asiatic) backbone - dj, tj, kh, h, sh, q, long -aa/-et endings, l tends to r, v tends to w, triconsonantal roots, theophoric on morphed canon-stems (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-, Riaret-) - meeting a Mayan overlay: glottalized stops b'/t'/k'/tz'/ch', x = sh, vowel-length and the final glottal stop, the agentive aj- (he of) / ix- (she of), vigesimal counting. Per the CSV: glottal stops mixed with gutturals, Egyptian solar-temple stress; grammar shifts toward VSO on triconsonantal stems with Mayan vigesimal root-patterns (the substrate counting and lineage forms) carried on Egyptian construct-chains. Theophoric on the Egyptian reflexes (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-) with Mayan morph variants (aj-Tulax, ix-Rialtaj).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; Egyptian clusters dj/tj/kh meeting Mayan glottalization (b'/t'/k'/tz') and the final glottal stop; long -aa/-et; the aj-/ix- agentive prefix over Per-/Niut-/Ta- construct toponyms; stress on the solar-temple register.

sound_changes: Mayan glottalized/ejective stops -> Egyptian inventory: b'>b, t'>t, k'>k/q, tz'>tj, ch'>tj/sh; the final glottal stop drops (ha'>ha, paa'>paa) or softens to -aa

Mayan vigesimal/lineage clusters and agentive prefixes adapt to Egyptian triconsonantal roots: aj-/ix- collapse into the stem or take an Egyptian -et feminine; -tun/-ab/-il endings reduce, roots take Egyptian -aa/-et
Egyptian dj/tj/kh and -aa/-et endings imposed on all words; l>r and v>w throughout; the solar-temple register sets VSO order
retain Egyptian dj/tj/kh and Mayan x (=sh) and glottal-softened -aa; very short roots take an Egyptian -aa/-et ending
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain (jungle/forest/cenote), pyramid/temple-structure, material and staple (jade, cacao, maize, obsidian, feather) words from Mayan roots (the substrate works the jungle and quarries the stone); rule/kin-line/temple-office/Nile-and-land/quality words from Egyptian roots (the ruling solar register); every root then filtered to one Egyptian-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Mayan jungle/pyramid/material/staple roots + Egyptian rule/kin/temple/Nile/land roots, all run through one Egyptian-shaped sound-law (dj/tj/kh, l>r, v>w, -aa/-et, glottal-softening); portmanteaus mark the blended river, pyramid, temple, bloodline, and jade-wealth.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Egyptian ruling house keeps the filiation 'sa' (son-of) and the theophoric construct; the Maya populace keep the ch'ib'al (lineage) and the aj-/ix- agentive on calendar-day names; the throne fuses both - a nesut who carries a Per- house-name and a ch'ib'al dynasty-count.
morphology.compounding_rule: Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god], Niut-[god], Ta-[land], Pa-[noun]) layered over Mayan [color|quality] + feature compounds (Chak-witz red-pyramid, softened to Chak-djew): the capital Ramaya (Ra-maya, the sun-jungle realm), Per-Tjuraa (temple of the sun) atop the Noh-Djewitz (the great temple-mountain).

title_ladder.government: feudal (an Egyptian solar god-kingship over the Maya jungle pyramid-cities: the per-aa and his nesut-court at the crown, the heqa-aa princes and sepati nomarchs over the river-and-jungle provinces, the k'uhul-ajaw holy-lords and sajal governors of the witz-cities serving beneath; the hem-netjer temple-priesthood and the ah-k'in day-keepers order the calendar)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Egyptian ladder, ascending, with the Maya substrate co-titles beneath. Hatia (mayor) barony; Wer-khaset (great-one of the frontier-land) march; Sepati/Sepat (nomarch/nome) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer/general) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut (king) kingdom - shown as 'Pharaoh', the approved commonly-known foreign rank; Per-aa (lit. the Great House) empire over the Per-aat. The conquered witz-cities keep their Maya k'uhul ajaw (holy lord) and sajal (governor) and batab' (local chief) beneath the Egyptian crown. The hem-netjer priests and the ah-k'in day-keepers stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Egyptian and Maya registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince); the baah-ch'ok (head-youth) of the Maya line

vassalage.fealty: Ankh (the living-oath) / Patan-t'an (Maya oath of service)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Egyptian ruling stock carry a theophoric given name + filiation (sa-X); the Maya populace carry a calendar-day name + ch'ib'al lineage with the aj-/ix- agentive; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Egyptian solar-aristocracy keep theophoric names (Tjuraa-hotep, Mery-Djeroraa, Sa-Riaret); the Maya city-folk keep calendar-day names (Aj-Balam, Ix-Kan) on the morphed canon-stems and their ch'ib'al.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Egyptian devotional on the morphed god-reflexes: X-hotep (X-is-content), X-mose (X-is-born), Mery-X (beloved-of-X), Sa-X (son-of-X) - Tjuraa-hotep, Mery-Djeroraa. Maya devotional with aj-/ix-: Aj-Tulax, Ix-Rialtaj.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Egyptian reflexes PRIMARY (abydosian sample_deity_renames, the morphed-through-Egyptian-phonology set), Mayan morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.mayan), never real Egyptian/Maya gods (no Ra, Osiris, Isis; no Itzamna, Kukulkan, Chaac). Shared Agrippan pantheon, two registers. The solar god-king ideology and the funerary cult meet the Long-Count calendar and the witz-pyramid altar; the per-aa and the k'uhul ajaw both mediate the powers. Ramaya seeds/shifts Lawful, Neutral, or Chaotic (see worship_by_alignment).
religion.the_one: Atjernaa (Egyptian; Maya Aj Ternaj) - the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tjuraa (Maya Tulax) - the sun and right-order
sample_deity_renames.Delorum: Djeroraa (Maya Aj Delor) - lord of the peaceful dead
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Riaret (Maya Ix Rialtaj) - the mother, mercy
sample_deity_renames.Raptis: Rapetj (Maya Aj Raptaj) - the red hunter

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Atjernaa the One, Tjuraa the just sun, Gaiandaa the enduring, Numenaa the wise - and names the Chaotic powers the kin of the great serpent Hefau (and the Maya Lusankaan), warded; the solar law-of-maat and the Long-Count order bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified dead (the akhu and the Maya uchben), the god-kings and the day-lords; the great powers invoked at the per-netjer and atop the witz situationally, somewhat honored and somewhat feared
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Atjernaa - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the bloodletting-rite feeds the devouring powers.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the kin of the great serpent Hefau (Egyptian) or the Maya demonized set, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhu the City-Burner (Maya Marakab the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Wakedjet the Devouring Hefau (Maya Wakix the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusandjaa the Hoard-Serpent (Maya Lusankaan).

clergy_ladder.9: Hem-netjer Aa (great prophet) / Ah-k'in Mai (high priest)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/temple) of [power], often atop the witz (pyramid): 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax atop the Djewitz'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified dead (the akhu and the Maya uchben) and the god-kings, venerated at tomb-pyramid and carved stela; 'the justified [name]' (maa-kheru) and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tjuraa: the sun-disc above the feather of right-order, set over the feathered-serpent glyph
holy_symbol_motifs.Djeroraa: the crook and flail crossed over a jade burial-mask
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaiandaa: the alluvial field beneath the stepped witz-pyramid

banks_patterns.military_units: the [god] Division and the Maya Holkan war-host: 'the Division of Rapetj', 'the Jaguar Holkan', 'the Feather-and-Sun Companies'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Lotus', 'The Cacao and Crown', 'The Golden Quetzal'
